headers:
# Response headers for every file of the hosted web preview (Cloudflare reads
# this file from the assets folder; scripts/prepare-cloudflare.mjs copies it).
# The site holds sample data and SEO is on hold until the hotel confirms, so
# search engines must not index it. The other lines are basic browser safety.
/*
  X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN

# Built scripts and styles have content hashes in their names, so browsers may
# keep them for a year.
/app/_next/static/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
